system.description:
A small metallic wristband, bracelet, watch, or cuff, which acts as the housing and charging unit for a nanogram swarm. When not in use, the nanogram swarm resides within a compartment within the device, charging from an internal kinetic battery.

The wearer of a Nanogram Controller gains a Nanogram Genius as a Companion NPC. This is a powered device, which recharges after a Break rest.
